name: Lagrangian Hashing
definition: A hybrid neural field representation that combines Eulerian hierarchical hash grids (from InstantNGP) with a Lagrangian point-based representation (from 3D Gaussian Splatting) to achieve memory efficiency and high-quality novel view synthesis.
summary: Lagrangian Hashing is a hybrid neural field that stores learnable Gaussian points within hash buckets, enabling adaptive detail allocation unlike static Eulerian grids.
